history.summary: Static review found the main scan-to-twin wiring present. Frontend build result was unavailable; backend tests were blocked by missing pytest and Python compile could not start because the configured interpreter path is missing. .env.example retained a model path inconsistent with the runtime mount/export contract.

Frontend build passed after dependencies were installed. Backend dependencies were available but focused tests exposed an invalid pre-confirmed fixture and pytest-asyncio incompatibility; the example model path was corrected.

Frontend production build, focused tests (3/3), Python compileall, and diff check passed. Model paths align; full-suite API test collection remains blocked by SlowAPI's missing request argument on get_advice, which is outside the focused goal criteria.
